Aetheris — YouTube API Setup Guide

Follow these steps to create your own YouTube Data API v3 key for Aetheris. The key is used to search YouTube for song requests.

Open Google Cloud ConsoleOfficial Google Setup Guide

1Create a Google Cloud project

Open Google Cloud Console. Click Select a project, choose New Project, enter a name such as Aetheris, then click Create.

2Enable YouTube Data API v3

With your new project selected, open APIs & Services. Choose Library, search for YouTube Data API v3, open it, and click Enable.

3Create an API key

Open Credentials. Click Create credentials and choose API key. You do not need an OAuth Client ID or Client Secret for Aetheris song search.

4Restrict and create the key

Name the key if desired. Under APIs that can be accessed using this key, restrict it to YouTube Data API v3, then click Create.

5Copy the key into Aetheris

After Google creates the key, copy it. Open Aetheris → Settings → YouTube and paste it into the masked YouTube API Key field.

Keep your API key private. Do not post it publicly or include it in screenshots, public issues, or shared configuration files.

How Aetheris uses it

The YouTube Data API key is used for song searching. YouTube Music Desktop's Companion Server is separate and handles playback control, realtime state, queue transitions, playlist rejoin, and shuffle.

Google applies quota limits to YouTube Data API requests. See the official quota documentation for details.
